about: Christopher D. Porter is an attorney who represents clients in the Houston, Texas area. Christopher Porter is recognized by peers and was selected to Super Lawyers for 2020 - 2026. This selection is based off of an evaluation of 12 indicators including peer recognition and professional achievement in legal practice.

Christopher Porter chose to pursue a career in law after completing undergraduate studies. He attended The University of Michigan Law School and graduated in 2008. Christopher Porter passed the bar exam and was admitted to legal practice in 2009.
He represents clients with Business Litigation issues in Texas.

Being selected to Super Lawyers is limited to a small number of attorneys in each state. As one of the few attorneys to garner the distinction of Super Lawyers, Christopher Porter has earned the respect of peers as one of the top-rated attorneys in the nation.

The Super Lawyers patented selection process is peer influenced and research driven, selecting the top 5% of attorneys to the Super Lawyers lists each year. We know lawyers and make it easy to connect with them.
